idea-plugin.name: Rememberable
idea-plugin.description:
IDE support for the Rememberable Kotlin compiler plugin (com.matuyuhi.rememberable).

Resolves @Rememberable generated Saver properties in K2 mode, eliminating false "Unresolved reference" errors in the editor.

Setup

  1. Apply the Gradle plugin in your project: 
    plugins {
    id("com.matuyuhi.rememberable") version "0.1.6"
}
  2. Install this IDE plugin

See GitHub for full documentation.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Initial release — K2 FIR extension support for IDE analysis
